page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results place this instance primarily in the lower performance tiers. In CPU-focused tests, it achieved a single-core stress-ng score of 1100.49 and a multi-core score of 2931.93, both categorized in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read speed of 163.82 GB/sec, but uncached read performance drops to 20.19 GB/sec, which is in the bottom 10%. Real-world application benchmarks, such as static web serving at 2.41 GB/sec and database operations scoring 1073.82 on Passmark, also reflect lower-tier performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1.xlarge offers a high memory capacity relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-performance CPU throughput. The lack of local storage and modest network bandwidth limit its utility for high-throughput data processing. It is best suited for workloads such as caching layers, lightweight database operations, or memory-heavy general-purpose applications that can tolerate lower processing speeds.
